faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) for filling up civil engineering leadership positions on deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notification is for the position of Group General Manager / General Manager (Civil) under the civil department of RITES.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Group General Manager / General Manager (Civil) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be SAG, NFSAG, or SG level IRSE officers to be eligible to apply for this deputation position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must not be more than 57 years of age as on the last date of submission of the application form.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive salary as per Level-13 or Level-14 of the 7th CPC, along with deputation allowance and perks.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online and offline application materials is 02 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the RITES career portal, print the form, and send it through proper channel along with email.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location after selection?
faq.answer: The primary job location for this specific posting is Guwahati, though candidates can be posted anywhere in India or abroad.

faq.question: Q10. What is the normal tenure of deputation?
faq.answer: The normal tenure of deputation is 3 years, which may be extended further depending upon organizational requirements and performance.
